packageRules.description: Commit dev dependency bumps (npm devDependencies; Python dependency-groups, uv and PDM dev-dependencies) as `chore(deps):` instead of inheriting a release-triggering `fix:`. Dev tooling is not the shipped product, so it should not cut a release. Must be extended AFTER semanticCommitType(*, fix): Renovate has no rule specificity, so the last matching packageRule wins.
